faq.a: People go through stages: baby, toddler, child, teenager, adult and older adult. Each stage brings new skills and body changes.
asks: What are the stages of human life?

faq.a: A toddler is a young child from about one to three years old who is learning to walk steadily and to talk.

faq.q: Why do teenagers grow so fast?
faq.a: Around the teenage years, the body makes growth chemicals called hormones that cause a growth spurt and change a child's body into an adult body. This is called puberty.

faq.q: Why do children lose their baby teeth?
faq.a: Baby teeth are small to fit a small mouth. As the jaw grows, adult teeth push up underneath, the baby tooth roots melt away, and the baby teeth fall out.
asks: Why do baby teeth fall out?

faq.q: When do people stop growing taller?
faq.a: Most people stop growing taller in their late teens, often between about 15 and 19 years old, when the growth zones in their bones close.
asks: How long do you keep growing?

facts: A newborn baby has about 300 bones, many of which fuse, leaving an adult with 206.
Most children start losing their baby teeth at about 6 years old.

quiz.say: Which stage comes straight after baby?
quiz.why: After the baby stage comes the toddler, from about one to three years.

wrong.0: Teenager comes much later, after childhood.
wrong.2: Adult comes after the teenage years.

quiz.say: Why does a grown-up have fewer bones than a baby?
quiz.show: A grown-up has fewer bones because…

options.show: Grown-ups lose bones when they fall
options.say: Grown-ups lose bones when they fall

quiz.why: Many small bones in a baby slowly join, or fuse, into bigger ones.

wrong.0: Bones do not fall out like baby teeth.
wrong.2: Falling can break a bone, but it does not take bones away.
